title: camera
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate a camera model built from cones, cubes, arrows, and spheres using vtkRotationalExtrusionFilter, vtkImplicitModeller, vtkWarpTo, and various transforms to create azimuth, elevation, roll, and DOP arrows.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkAppendFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkAppendFilter.html) — append filter.
- [vtkCellArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellArray.html) — cell array.
- [vtkConeSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkConeSource.html) — generates a polygonal cone.
- [vtkContourFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkContourFilter.html) — extracts iso-surfaces at specified scalar values.
- [vtkCubeSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCubeSource.html) — cube source.
- [vtkDataSetMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetMapper.html) — maps any dataset type to graphics primitives.
- [vtkImplicitModeller](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImplicitModeller.html) — implicit modeller.
- [vtkLODActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLODActor.html) — lod actor.
- [vtkPoints](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPoints.html) — stores 3D point coordinates.
- [vtkPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyData.html) — represents polygonal geometry.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkRotationalExtrusionFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRotationalExtrusionFilter.html) — rotational extrusion filter.
- [vtkSphereSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSphereSource.html) — generates a tessellated sphere.
- [vtkTransform](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTransform.html) — defines a 4x4 geometric transformation.
- [vtkTransformFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTransformFilter.html) — applies a geometric transformation to a dataset.
- [vtkTransformPolyDataFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTransformPolyDataFilter.html) — transform poly data filter.
- [vtkWarpTo](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkWarpTo.html) — warp to.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
